answer: Commit a hash of the result, reveal it after the claim window, and match it against two independent replays. A mismatch burns 25 percent of the bond. A farm submits 1,000 commits, reveals late, and pays 250 bonds per bad batch. The vertex of the cost is the reveal window: an ocean of committed work buys nothing until it opens, and a dune of clones cannot audit its own members.
